business_and_profit_drivers: Cold-rolled stainless steel strip is a high-throughput, low-margin spread business driven by utilization, processing spread and raw-material/pass-through discipline.
Domestic stainless demand and supply discipline determine base-cycle margins.
Thailand/overseas and new capacity ramp can improve utilization and mix but require capital and execution.
Inventory and bank-acceptance/debt funding create material working-capital and liquidity sensitivity.
Convertible bond economics and governance quality affect per-share value and valuation multiple.

capital_comparison.judgment: At current price probability-weighted upside is only ~2%, below cash and capital hurdles. Re-underwrite around RMB21.50 rather than buying mechanically when the price gate is crossed.

d2_answers.fact: 2026H1 revenue RMB22.75bn, attributable NP RMB0.360bn, CFO RMB0.267bn; Q2 gross margin 5.64%.
d2_answers.question: Normalize earnings and cash flow

d2_answers.fact: Inventory RMB4.626bn, +30.93% vs year-end; liability ratio 58.38%.
d2_answers.question: Financial quality and balance sheet

d2_answers.judgment: BUY_BELOW RMB21.50; price crossing triggers fresh D2 only, never automatic buy.
d2_answers.question: Capital comparison

financial_quality.governance: One actual controller was convicted in 2026 for insider trading/leaking inside information; while the company says operations are unaffected, this warrants a governance discount in valuation.
financial_quality.judgment: Profit inflection is credible, but cash conversion is weaker than reported profit and inventory expanded materially. The balance sheet can fund the cycle, yet the business deserves no premium multiple until working capital normalizes.

market_implied_expectation.interpretation: At ~12.4x the base normalized EPS, current price already assumes that Q2 margin improvement is substantially sustainable and leaves little probability-weighted upside.

source_quality_note: Operating and balance-sheet facts are anchored to formal disclosures; governance fact is from the company's disclosed judgment notice. Scenario EPS, multiples, probabilities and entry gate are analytical assumptions and authorize no trade.

thesis.core: The 2026Q2 margin and profit improvement is real, but this remains a low-margin, working-capital- and capital-intensive stainless cold-rolling business. Current price is already near a fair base-case value while inventory, leverage/cash conversion and governance deserve a discount.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use normalized EPS RMB1.45/RMB2.05/RMB2.50 under bear/base/bull rather than annualizing the strong 2026Q2 quarter; apply 10x/12.5x/15x multiples reflecting cyclicality, thin margins, balance-sheet intensity and governance discount.
thesis.variant_wedge: Momentum correctly identifies an operating inflection, but the market is already capitalizing much of it. A better entry requires either a price reset or evidence that normalized EPS and free-cash-flow conversion can move materially above the current base case.

catalysts: Q2 gross/net margin improvement persists through H2 without inventory build accelerating.
Thailand/overseas capacity reaches utilization with acceptable ROIC and cash conversion.
Industry capacity digestion improves stainless processing spreads.
Operating cash flow catches up with earnings while inventory and debt normalize.
kill_thesis: Gross margin mean-reverts toward or below roughly 4.5% without a temporary explanation.
Inventory, short-term funding and receivables continue rising faster than revenue while CFO remains below earnings.
New governance or related-party/control issues materially raise capital-allocation risk.
Convertible/dilution or expansion capex reduces per-share returns without a commensurate ROIC improvement.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Base sits around an improved but not peak normalized run-rate; Q2 is not annualized mechanically.
